title: Smell and memory
summary: A puff of odor enters the antenna, and the mushroom body decides whether that smell matters.

stimuli.name: Smell receptors
stimuli.label: Turns on the receptor neurons that first catch an odor at the antenna.

silence.name: Projection neurons
silence.label: Stops the antennal lobe from carrying that smell into the mushroom body.

silence.name: Kenyon cells
silence.label: Quiets the cells that tell one smell apart from another.

silence.name: Output neurons
silence.label: Blocks the mushroom body from passing the result to the rest of the brain.
